LEASE AGREEMENT 
 This Lease Agreement (the “ Agreement ”) is made at Lahore on this ___ day of August , 2020 by and between

 M r . __________________ S/o ________________ , holding CNIC No. ______________________ , resident of ___________________________________________ (the “ Lessor 2 ”); and 
 M r . [ ● ] S/o [ ● ], holding CNIC No. [ ● ], resident of [ ● ] (the “ Lessor 3 ”) ( Lessor 1, Lessor 2 and Lessor 3 hereinafter jointly referred to as the “Lessor s ” which term shall, wherever the context so permits or requires, means and includes their successors-in-interest, legal heirs and assigns) 
 
 AND 
 
 OLX Classifieds Pakistan (SMC-Private) Limited, having its registered office at 90-B Hali Road, Gulberg II, Lahore , through its authorized representative, Mr. [ ● ] (hereinafter referred to as the “ Lessee ” which expression shall mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns). 
 ( The Lessors and Lessee h ereinafter collectively referred to as the “ Parties ” and “ Party ” shall mean any one of them) 
 WHEREAS: 
 
 The Lessor s are the absolute and lawful owner in possession of the commercial eight-storied building located at 29-Q, College Road, Gulberg II, Lahore (the “ Building ”) with an area measuring a total of [ ● ] sq.ft . 
 The Lessee , on reliance of the aforementioned representation made by the Lessors, has agreed to take on lease and the Lessors have agreed to let [ ● description of floor(s) etc] along with amenities and utilities attached thereto , (the “ Demised Premises ”) , on rental basis, upon terms and conditions stated hereunder . 
 Now Therefore , it is hereby agreed between the Parties as under: 
 
 Scope 
 The Demised Premises consisting of an area measuring a total of [ ● ] sq. ft., as per the floor plan of the Demised Premises attached herewith as Annexure A will be let on rental basis by the Lessor s to be used by the Lessee for purpose of conducting its business. 
 During the Term of this Agreement, the Lessor s shall also provide , or cause to be provided , through a management and services company , maintenance services to the Lessee . The maintenance services shall includ e inter alia installation and maintenance of l ifts, s ervice areas, water leakage, drainage, fire sprinklers, infrastructure issues, ATS and electric metres, ATS panel and warranty of equipment installed by the Lessors (the “ Maintenance Services ”). 
 Term 
 This Agreement shall be effective for a period of five (5) years , commencing on [ ● ] August , 2020 (the “ Effective Date ”) ending on [ ● ] August , 202 5 or on such other date as may be agreed mutually between the Parties in writing (the “ Term ”) . 
 Monthly &amp; Advance Rent 
 The Lessee shall pay to the Lessor s a monthly rent of Rupees [ ● ] (PKR [ ● ] ), inclusive of all taxes (the “ Monthly Rent ”) for the Demised Premises which shall be payable upon lapse of the Renovation Period ( defined below ). The Monthly Rent includes parking and Maintenance Services charges . 
 The Lessor s shall grant to the Lessee a rent-free period from [ ● ] August 2020 to 31 st December, 2020 for the purpose of undertaking renovations, modifications and alterations (“ Renovation Period ”). For the avoidance of doubt, the Lessor s confirm that no rent, fees or any other charges shall be charged to the Lessee during the Renovation Period. Accordingly, the Monthly Rent shall be payable from 1 st January, 2021 until the expiry of the Term, subject to terms and conditions of this Agreement. 
 Upon lapse of the Renovation Period , the Lessee shall pay to the Lessor s Monthly Rent for three (3) months as advance amounting to a total of Rupees [ ● ] (PKR [ ● ] ), inclusive of all taxes (the “ Advance Rent ”), i.e. for the period commencing 1 st January, 2021 and ending on 31 st March, 2021 (the “ Advance Rent Period ”). 
 After the lapse of the Advance Rent Period, t he Monthly Rent shall be paid by the Lessee to the Lessor s in advance on a monthly basis on or before the [ ● ] day of each month . 
 The Monthly Rent shall be divided equally between Lessor 1, Lessor 2 and Lessor 3 and shall be paid by the Lessor through a bank instrument or cheque in favour of Lessor 1, Lessor 2 and Lessor 3, the receipt whereof shall be acknowledged in writing by the Lessor s . 
 If for any period the Demised Premises may be rendered uninhabitable, due to the fault of or breach of any obligation of the Lessors under the Agreement , the Lessee shall not be under an obligation to pay the Monthly Rent, utility charges or any other charges for such uninhabitable period . Furthermore, the Term of this Agreement shall automatically be extended for a period equal to the uninhabitable period. 
 The Monthly Rent shall be subject to 25% rental increment after three (3) years. 
 Security Deposit 
 Upon the signing of this Agreement, the Lessee shall deposit with the Lessor s a sum equal to four (4) months’ Monthly Rent amounting to a total of Rupees [●] ( PKR [●]) as security (the “ Security Deposit ”) which shall be refunded to the Lessee upon expiry or termination of this Agreement in the manner set out in Clause 10.5 . The Security Deposit is hereby paid by the Lessee vide crossed cheque Nos. [ ● ], [ ● ] and [ ● ] drawn on [ ● ] Bank in favour of [ ‘ ● names of all three Lessors] ’ . The receipt s of the Security Deposit are hereby acknowledged by the Lessor s and attached herewith in Annexure B . 
 The Security Deposit shall not be adjusted against the Monthly Rent. Any deduction from Security Deposit shall be strictly limited and exclusively in relation to outstanding utility bills , service and maintenance charges and damage to the Demised Premises (other than regular wear and tear) during the Term. 
 Prior to making any deductions under Clause 4.2 from the Security Deposit, the Lessor s shall notify the Lessee in writing of such deductions. The said notice shall specify the amount to be deducted and the reasons for any such deductions. 
 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, the Lessee shall hand over peaceful and vacant possession of the Demised Premises to the Lessor s upon a refund of the Security Deposit after deductions and adjustments made in accordance wit h Clause 4.2 and Monthly Rent for unutilised l ease p eriod (if any). 
 Tax 
 The Lessee shall be entitled, empowered and authorized to deduct/withhold all taxes from the Monthly Rent as required by applicable laws and the taxes so deducted/withheld shall be deposited by the Lessee with the Government Treasury and the copies of such paid up challans shall be provided to the Lessor s . 
 The Lessor s shall pay property and other applicable taxes, charges or fees related to Demised Premises as and when due . 
 Lessors Obligations 
 The Lessor s shall handover the vacant possession of the Demised Premises to the Lessee on [ ● ] (the “ Possession Date ”) together with its keys (including electronic keys and/or smart cards) or password to security devices which shall be occupied by the Lessee during the Term as per the terms and conditions of this Agreement. 
 The Lessors are responsible for the constructions and installation of equipment detailed hereinbelow as per the requirement of the Lessee : 
 Construction of washrooms and ablution area; 
 Kitchen extension on every floor; 
 Levelling or tiling of floors; 
 Paint work of the Demised Premises excluding ceiling paint; 
 Lift installation, lighting and ceiling of the adjacent area; 
 Tuff tiles shall be placed at the entrance and around the building; 
 Staircase marble or tiles along with railing excluding staircase railing of mezzanine floor; 
 Construction of the Genset placement area in the building any extra or separate earthing will be done by the Lessors; 
 Glass work at the ground floor; 
 Removal of shop walls at the ground and mezzanine floors to make them complete halls; 
 Installation of s afety signs (HSE) and evacuation plan; and 
 Installation and maintenance of ATS panel . 
 The Lessor shall make available and permit the use of two rooms in the basement of the Building as guard, store and control rooms and shall also provide adequate space for parking vehicles and placing generators. 
 The Lessor s shall ensure that the Lessee enjoys quiet and peaceful possession of the Demised Premises during the Term particularly during office hours (9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.), without any disturbance or hindrance, and without interruption for any reason whatsoever during office hours, including inter alia any construction, repair or maintenance work. 
 The Lessor s shall ensure that repair and maintenance of the Demised Premises is regularly conducted by the m anagement c ompany as and when required. In case the Lessor s fails to do so, the Lessee may carry out all such repair and maintenance work at the cost of the Lessor s and shall deduct such expense/cost from the Monthly Rent. 
 In the event that repair or maintenance work is required to be carried out by the Lessor s at the Demised Premises, the Lessor s shall notify the Lessee three (3) days in advance of any such repair and maintenance. However, the Lessor s shall conduct all repairs and maintenance work during business hours (9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.) without causing any nuisance, excessive noise or disturbance to the Lessee, its employees and business. 
 The Lessor s or Lessors ’ representative(s) shall only be able to access the Demised Premises during business hours and with the prior permission of the Lessee and in the presence or supervision of the Lessee or its representative(s). 
 Lessee’s Rights &amp; Obligations 
 The Lessee shall use the Demised Premises for the commercial and business purposes only. 
 The Lessee shall be responsible to pay all charges for water, sewerage, electricity, gas, telephone and telecommunication, cable television, back-up generator etc. (“ Utility Charges ”) as per use and billing during the Term .  Subject to the terms of this Agreement, the Lessee shall have all the rights available to a lessee under the laws of the jurisdiction, including but not limited to right of access, approach, movement into and from the Demised Premises (including any common or shared areas) and right to conduct its business without hindrance. 
 Representations and Warranties by the Lessor s 
 The Lessor s hereby represent and warrant that: 
 A t the time of execution of this Agreement, the Demised Premises is free from any defect of title, lien, charge, or any encumbrance of whatsoever nature, and that the Demised Premises shall remain unencumbered throughout the Term , and any subsequent renewal of the same ; 
 The Demised Premises shall be free from all sorts of defects and the Lessee shall have access to all basic facilities and utilities throughout the Term ; 
 The Lessor s are the absolute and lawful owner of the Demised Premises and the Lessor s shall provide a copy of the necessary ownership documents to the Lessee at the time of signing of this Agreement ; 
 The Lessor s has the full legal right and capacity to lease the Demised Premises ; and 
 The Lessor s are in complete compliance with and ha ve obtained and maintained all building permits/licenses, NOCs, including approved map, commercialization certificate, building completion certificate, temporary permits/licenses in relation to the Building and is in complete compliance with all laws, rules and regulations of federal, state or local of the jurisdiction such that any failure of compliance will not have an adverse effect on the Lessor’s ability to enter, execute, deliver or consummate this Agreement . 
 No representation or warranty by the Lessor s made under this Agreement, nor any statement or certificates, permits and documents furnished or to be furnished by the Lessor s pursuant to this Agreement, contain or shall contain any false, incomplete, untruthful or inaccurate statement of material facts. 
 Representations &amp; Warranties by the Lessee 
 The Lessee undertakes and covena nts that : 
 T he Lessee shall keep the Demised Premises in clean and good tenable condition during the Term; and 
 The Lessee will use and occupy the Demised Premises for its lawful business purpose only . 
 Termination 
 The Lessors may terminate this Agreement by giving at least six ( 6 ) month s prior written notice to the other Party , and the Agreement shall stand terminated on the lapse of such notice period . 
 The Lessee may terminate this Agreement by giving three ( 3 ) month s prior written notice to the other Party, and the Agreement shall stand terminated on the lapse of such notice period. 
 In the event that any Party is in material breach of the terms and conditions of the Agreement, then the other Party (“ Affected Party ”), by giving at least thirty (30) days written notice to the Party in breach, to cure of such material breach within aforementioned thirty (30) days. If the breach continues beyond this notice period or is irreversible, the Affected Party may terminate this Agreement without further notice . 
 This Agreement may also be terminated without notice by the Lessee in case the Lessor s fail to hand over possession of the Demised Premises within [ ● ] days of the Possession Date. 
 Upon such termination of this Agreement under Clauses 1 0 .1, 1 0 .2 and 1 0 .3, the Lessee shall hand over peaceful and vacant possession of the Demised Premises to the Lessor s upon a refund of the Monthly Rent for unutilised lease period (if any) and the Security Deposit after deductions and adjustments made in accordance with this Agreement. 
 Force Majeure 
 A Party shall be released from their respective obligations in the event of national emergency, war, prohibitive governmental regulation , pandemic, government lockdown, or any other cause(s) beyond the reasonable control of such Party which renders the performance of this Agreement by either Party impossible in whole or part , for a period of time equal to the period of time of the event of force majeure . 
 Jurisdiction &amp; Arbitration 
 This Agreement shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of Pakistan. 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to this Agreement, if not amicably resolved between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of it so arising, shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940, upon serving of notice by either Party to the other Party. T he place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language for arbitration shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator(s), as the case may be, shall be final and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 Indemnity 
 The Lessor s hereby agree to defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Lessee against all losses, damages, adverse claims, proceedings, charges, penalties, fines, etc. resulting from or arising out of any breach of the Lessor’s obligations under this Agreement, including but not limited to any of his representations , warranty or covenant stated herein not being true, correct, complete or complied with and/or arising out of or in relation to any action, error, omission or negligence of the Lessor s . 
 Entire Agreement 
 This Agreement and the Annexures hereto shall constitute the entire Agreement and understanding between the Parties concerning the subject matter hereof. No amendment or change hereof or addition hereto shall be effective or binding, unless set forth in writing and executed by both the Parties. 
 Relationship between the Parties 
 Nothing in this Agreement (or any of the arrangements contemplated by it) is or shall be deemed to constitute a partnership between the Parties nor constitute either Party as the agent of the other for any purpose. 
 
 Notices 
 All notices, requests, communications required under the Agreement shall be delivered via email or registered post. Emails shall be deemed to have been delivered after twenty-four (24) hours of being sent. Written notices shall be deemed to have been delivered after three (03) working days of being posted, provided such notices were sent via a reputable courier company. The contact details of the Lessors and Lessee’s representatives for the purpose of notices shall be as follows: 
 Lessor s Attention of: [ ● ] Address: [ ● ] 
 
 
 Lessee Attention of: [ ● ] Address: 90-B, Hali Road, Gulberg II, Lahore 
 
 Waiver 
 No failure or delay in exercising any right or remedy hereunder shall operate as a waiver thereof nor shall any single or partial exercise or waiver of any right or remedy preclude its further exercise or the exercise of any other right or remedy, whether of a similar or different nature. 
 
 Severability 
 The provisions of this Agreement are severable. In case any provision of this Agreement shall be invalid, illegal or otherwise unenforceable, the validity, legality and enforceability of the remaining provisions shall in no way be affected or impaired thereby. Parties shall substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question. 
 
 Counterparts 
 This Agreement may be entered into in any number of counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same.
